work.title: Centralize Work discovery and resolution
work.description: Extract the repeated logic that discovers Work IDs from manifest refs, archive refs, and legacy base projections into a WorkLocator, which also resolves short Work codes such as INIT-x.y.
acceptance: list() and short-code resolution use the same enumeration logic
Work locations are returned with their source
Duplicate or ambiguous identities are detected deterministically
Git commands are not duplicated between listing and resolution
